text:
maya: FYI legal just forwarded a DSAR — EU data subject requests deletion of all embeddings and generated artifacts tied to their email. They attached signed ID. Need to confirm deletion path and whether backups/snapshots need retention exception.
samir: I can take the deletion. Quick Q: were embeddings stored in S3 + encrypted with KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/embeddings-key? Or are we using the customer-keystore path for this tenant? 
linda-legal: Confirmed the DSAR form + ID are sufficient per our checklist. If any backups exist beyond retention window we need a documented retention-exception approval. Legal can approve conditional exception if we log chain-of-custody and produce proof of destruction.
maya: tenant is on hosted, standard keystore. We shadowed embeddings to long-term snapshot bucket monthly — snapshot name pattern: embeddings-snap-YYYYMM. Samir, if you delete live objects we still might have those snaps.
samir: Ok. Plan: 1) disable access to tenant via RBAC role change for "embeddings-read" (temp revoke) 2) run deletion job to remove keys and S3 objects 3) run KMS schedule to rotate/revoke data key material and then schedule customer-keystore purge. Need an ops SRE to confirm snapshot pruning and cross-region copies.
jon-eng: I can do RBAC change. Proposed terraform snippet to create a short-lived deny:
```
resource "redwood_rbac_role_binding" "temp_revoke" {
  role = "embeddings-read"
  principal = "tenant:12345"
  expires_at = "2026-03-23T15:00:00Z"
  action = "deny"
}
```
samir: Perfect. After RBAC revoke, I'll run deletion script:
```
# delete objects and remove KMS data key
python tools/delete_embeddings.py --tenant 12345 --confirm
aws kms schedule-key-deletion --key-id alias/embeddings-key --pending-window-in-days 7
```
linda-legal: Do not schedule KMS key deletion until legal confirms snapshot status. If snapshots contain identifiers we need retention exception or manual scrub + verification.
ops-bot: (automated) Snapshot inventory for tenant 12345: embeddings-snap-202512 (r:eastus) , embeddings-snap-202602 (r:us-west-2). Cross-region replica exists for 202602.
maya: cross-region copy is the tricky bit. Samir, can you list S3 object versions and run redaction on snapshot copies? If we can't scrub, legal says we need exception workflow doc + JIRA ticket.
samir: I'll attempt in-place redact and then produce sha256 manifest. If redact fails due to format we escalate. Action: starting RBAC revoke now @jon-eng
jon-eng: done — binding created, tenant blocked. timestamp 1851235000
samir: started deletion job; deleting live objects first. will post deletion-ops log when done. timestamp 1851236000
audit-bot: (audit) DELETE_JOB_STARTED id=del-8f3a user=samir ts=1851236005
samir: deletion job removed 18,342 objects, purged local KV cache and issued KMS rewrap for data keys. Deleting snapshots next. timestamp 1851236500
ops-bot: (automated) Snapshot prune attempt: embeddings-snap-202512 redaction=partial, embeddings-snap-202602 redaction=failed (replica read-only). Created retention-exception request REQ-9087.
linda-legal: Reviewed REQ-9087. We can approve a narrow exception limited to timeboxed restore/inspect window solely for redaction, must be logged and access restricted to named engineers. Approving until 2026-03-28. Please attach audit manifests.
samir: I have manifest and KMS operation logs. audit-bot, please produce chain-of-custody bundle.
audit-bot: (audit) CHAIN_OF_CUSTODY created id=coc-185123-a1 artifacts=[manifest.txt, kms-log.json, s3-list.txt] ts=1851237700
maya: thanks everyone — next steps: samir finish redaction and attach manifest to REQ-9087, linda will sign exception, jon will re-enable RBAC after confirmation, ops will ensure replica prune. We'll keep legal notified. Closing thread when coc delivered.
samir: uploaded manifest and redaction proof to REQ-9087. final deletion log id=del-8f3a-compl ts=1851237888
linda-legal: Exception signed. Confirmed deletion and redaction artifacts. This satisfies DSAR. Closing from legal side.
ops-bot: (automated) RBAC restore scheduled at 2026-03-24T10:00:00Z unless manual hold. ts=1851237890
